description:
Dispatch to the chosen backend and wire it through the server + CLI.

- `src/backends/index.ts`: `createBackend(config, copilotInstr, deps)` reads `config.provider` → `createCodexBackend | createGeminiBackend` (both return `ReviewBackend`). This file MAY import both backends; the config layer still must not.
- server.ts:81 and cli/commands.ts:74 call `createBackend` instead of `createCodexClient`.
- Lazy/dynamic-load each backend's heavy bits so the unused provider never initializes (today `new Codex()` runs eagerly in the factory — wasteful and can fail if that provider's env is absent). 
- Adversarial caveat: if making the factory async ripples sync→async into server.ts:81 and the CLI call sites (commands.ts:128/170/208), either await it at the already-async entry points OR do the dynamic import once at module init keyed by config.provider and keep the factory sync. Pick one deliberately.

Acceptance: provider:'codex' and provider:'gemini' both work end-to-end via MCP and CLI; only the selected provider's SDK/binary initializes.
title: Backend selection layer + wire entry points
